comment: If you're in search of a good + affordable Type-C earphones, I'll definitely recommend this one from Baseus.  Fits almost all devices that have Type-C plug-in and is fittingly yet securely attached without the wobbly/lousy fit. All the buttons are functioning well too plus the position of the buttons is perfectly reachable in any situation.  I mainly used this for gaming purposes but I do use it for casual listening and once-in-a while phone calls as well.  I noticed that it has a decent bass; it's there but not enough to raise your adrenaline (it's like thump-thump instead of THUMP-THUMP haha).  As for the clarity of the sound, I think it leans more towards the muffled side and I noticed this especially when I played Wuthering Waves + AFK Journey where the voice sounds quite far from the ear and I need to raise the volume up to like 85% to hear it more clearer. This also applies when I'm listening to the music (I think mellow songs might hits different with this earphone)  But I think it differs with games that have in-app settings like Ash Echoes does where the sound is extremely clearer and I can even hear the faintest sound in the background. Splendid indeed!  I haven't used any in-app call function but I do answer the phone call using this earphone and I can say it's quite crisp and clear without the static sound.  Noise cancelation is quite good as I definitely can't hear my mom's voice when the volume is around 85% hahaha. It's good to cover outside noise especially when you're working with earphones on.  The earphone design fits snugly inside the ears and it neither hurts my ears at all nor slips off easily. Definitely loves the gendut design hahaha.

comment: If you're in search of a good + affordable Type-C earphones, I'll definitely recommend this one from Baseus.  Fits almost all devices that have Type-C plug-in and is fittingly yet securely attached without the wobbly/lousy fit. All the buttons are functioning well too plus the position of the buttons is perfectly reachable in any situation.  I mainly used this for gaming purposes but I do use it for casual listening and once-in-a while phone calls as well.  I noticed that it has a decent bass; it's there but not enough to raise your adrenaline (it's like thump-thump instead of THUMP-THUMP haha).  As for the clarity of the sound, I think it leans more towards the muffled side and I noticed this especially when I played Wuthering Waves + AFK Journey where the voice sounds quite far from the ear and I need to raise the volume up to like 85% to hear it more clearer. This also applies when I'm listening to the music (I think mellow songs might hits different with this earphone)  But I think it differs with games that have in-app settings like Ash Echoes does where the sound is extremely clearer and I can even hear the faintest sound in the background. Splendid indeed!  I haven't used any in-app call function but I do answer the phone call using this earphone and I can say it's quite crisp and clear without the static sound.  Noise cancelation is quite good as I definitely can't hear my mom's voice when the volume is around 85% hahaha. It's good to cover outside noise especially when you're working with earphones on.  The earphone design fits snugly inside the ears and it neither hurts my ears at all nor slips off easily. Definitely loves the gendut design hahaha.

comment: Performance:Good Quality:More Than Expected  Baseus or calls it 'Base-Us' is a China based company manufactures smart electronic accessories for phones & car.  (1)About this earphone, it has 2 types. CZ11 is for type C connector on phone, and HZ11 is 3.5mm Jack connector (a standard analog audio connector). So before buy, check your phone's type of connector first.  (2)About this earphone, it's comfortable to wear in ear to listening songs, as the earbuds curvatures are fits into ear's canal, but not comfortable to wear it to sleep with listening songs.  (3)About the sound's quality, the bass indeed is strong & punchy. But the treble is not balanced with the bass. As we understood, bass is low frequency & treble is high frequency to provides a crips clear vocals. But I finds the treble is not very balance & with hissing sound.  (4)About using this earphone with better sound performance, you have to manually set from your phone, coz it doesn't comes with a volume adjuster. If you didn't adjust the sound from your phone & just using it, you'll find the bass & sound all are quite 'flat'. Here's how you adjust manually from your phone. Go to your phone's Music File→Sound Effect→Choose In Ear (not earbuds & headphones)→System Sound Effect→Choose 6D (6D means 6 Dimensions, Left, Right, Front, Back, Up, Down, or maybe some other phones are with 3D, 8D, 16D & XD)→Sound Effect→Wide or Grand are the best, or if you like others like Concert Hall or Studio may do as well→Equalizer→Choose Pop/Rock/Dance/Deep/Electro/Hip Hop/Bass/Mega Bass/Dolby Atmos→Adjust volume to maximum. These are the steps for people that likes strong punchy bass with Rave, Techno, Pop & Electro songs. For others that likes Jazz, Classical, Orchestras, I think this earphone is not quite suitable for these range of songs / musics.  (5)This earphone is a plug in type to your phone, not a Bluetooth type. Also is not waterproof. And I finds it didn't totally block / noise cancellation from outer noise / sounds. It's just an average listening but if at a very noisy place, you'll still hear outer sounds / noice.  Lastly, I rate this earphone's quality a 4 star out of 5. Considered good but not excellent or the best. Suitable to use it for blasting heavy punchy bass Electro & Rave music in private without disturbing others. But for this price buying at RM12.54 included shipping & cash back vouchers, I'll say it's a worth buying.
